name: The Power Of The Tongue
overview: Scripture reveals the profound influence of the tongue, emphasizing the need for careful speech and self-control. The Psalms express a heartfelt desire for words and meditations to be pleasing to the Lord, recognizing Him as strength and redeemer. Proverbs contrasts the destructive potential of careless words with the wisdom found in restraint, highlighting that a soft answer can defuse anger while harsh words provoke it. Ultimately, guarding one’s speech is linked to preserving life and promoting health, underscoring the spiritual responsibility believers have over their tongues.
